# Frequency / sound beds (under voice)

**Current files are temporary placeholders** (soft 20s tones generated by `npm run beds:placeholders` / `node scripts/generate-placeholder-beds.js`). Replace with production beds from Success Center / your engineer when ready - keep the same base names.

| File | Intent |
|------|--------|
| `calm_delta.wav` | Restorative overnight |
| `heart_coherence.wav` | Soft rhythmic / emotional |
| `focus_clarity.wav` | Mental clarity |
| `abundance_warm.wav` | Warm confidence |
| `neutral_music.wav` | Classic CGMR-style drone placeholder |

App paths: `/audio/beds/<name>.wav`  
Mix: duck under spoken Goal Manifestation voice; never replace suggestions.
